message.content: {"predictors": [{"name": "Short-Term Accrual Volatility", "construction": "Calculate the standard deviation of quarterly short-term accruals (change in current assets minus change in current liabilities, scaled by average total assets) over the past 8 quarters.", "rationale": "Firms with volatile accruals may face greater uncertainty in earnings quality, which could be mispriced by investors.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "R&D Intensity Change", "construction": "Compute the year-over-year percentage change in R&D expense divided by total assets.", "rationale": "Firms increasing R&D intensity may be investing in future growth opportunities not yet recognized by the market.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Dividend Initiation Momentum", "construction": "Indicator variable equal to 1 if a firm initiated a dividend in the past 12 months and 0 otherwise.", "rationale": "Dividend initiations may signal management confidence and improved future prospects.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Inventory Write-Down Frequency", "construction": "Count the number of inventory write-downs disclosed in annual reports over the past 5 years.", "rationale": "Frequent write-downs may indicate poor inventory management or persistent operational issues.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "Relative Insider Net Buying", "construction": "Sum net insider purchases (purchases minus sales) over the past 6 months, scaled by shares outstanding.", "rationale": "Insider buying may reflect private information about undervaluation or positive future developments.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Patent Application Growth", "construction": "Year-over-year percentage change in the number of patent applications filed by the firm, as reported in public filings.", "rationale": "Rising patent activity may signal innovation and future competitive advantage.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Deferred Tax Asset Ratio", "construction": "Deferred tax assets divided by total assets, as reported in the most recent annual report.", "rationale": "High deferred tax assets may indicate aggressive accounting or future earnings headwinds.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "Customer Concentration Risk", "construction": "Percentage of total sales to the firm's largest customer, as disclosed in annual filings.", "rationale": "High customer concentration exposes firms to idiosyncratic risk that may not be fully priced.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "Seasonal Sales Growth Consistency", "construction": "Standard deviation of year-over-year quarterly sales growth rates for the same quarter over the past 4 years.", "rationale": "Consistent seasonal sales growth may indicate stable demand and operational strength.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "Unrecognized Pension Liability Ratio", "construction": "Unrecognized pension liabilities divided by market capitalization, as disclosed in footnotes of annual reports.", "rationale": "Large unrecognized pension liabilities may represent hidden financial risk.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}]}
